dictionary.Category: Derived. See READ ME for the exact rule per category.
dictionary.Fox Class: AAM only. Fox 1 = SARH, Fox 2 = IR, Fox 3 = ARH. Blank for surface-attack weapons.
dictionary.Guidance Family: Plain-English seeker type behind the category.
dictionary.Targets Air: Seeker accepts aircraft targets (radarSeeker.aircraftAsTarget / optical without surface flags).
dictionary.Targets Surface: Seeker accepts ground or ship targets (surfaceAsTarget / groundVehiclesAsTarget).
dictionary.Air-Launched: Yes = an aircraft file references this weapon. Unconfirmed = no reference found; NOT proof it is ground-only.
dictionary.Carrier Aircraft Count: Number of distinct aircraft referencing this exact weapon file.
dictionary.Min BR (RB): Lowest Realistic Battle Rating among aircraft that carry this weapon. From wpcost.blkx economicRankHistorical: BR = (rank//3)+1 plus 0 / .3 / .7.
dictionary.Median BR (RB): Median Realistic BR across carrying aircraft. Better 'where does this live' signal than the minimum, which is usually one outlier airframe.
dictionary.Max BR (RB): Highest Realistic BR among carrying aircraft.
dictionary.BR Spread (RB): Max minus Min. A wide spread means the weapon appears across very different matchmaking brackets.
dictionary.Lowest-BR Carrier: The airframe that brings this weapon to the lowest Realistic BR. This is the downtier threat case.
dictionary.Highest-BR Carrier: The airframe carrying it at the highest Realistic BR.
dictionary.Carrier Nations: Distinct tech-tree nations operating a carrying aircraft (from wpcost country field, not the weapon's origin).
dictionary.Bullet ID: rocket.bulletName — canonical id, shared across mount variants.
dictionary.Is Variant: Yes if the file name carries a mount/loadout suffix.
dictionary.Raw bulletType: Untouched rocket.bulletType, for auditing the classifier.
dictionary.Burnout Mass (kg): rocket.massEnd1 if a second stage exists, else rocket.massEnd.
dictionary.Warhead Mass (kg): rocket.warheadMass — warhead section, not explosive filler.
dictionary.Explosive Mass (kg): rocket.explosiveMass, in the units of Explosive Type.
dictionary.HEAT Penetration (mm): cumulativeDamage.armorPower — shaped-charge penetration. Present on ATGMs and some AGMs.
dictionary.HEAT Pen Standoff (m): cumulativeDamage.distance — standoff the figure is quoted at.
dictionary.Stage 1 Thrust (N): rocket.force, or propulsion0.impulse0.force where that block is used.
dictionary.Stage 2 Thrust (N): rocket.force1 — sustainer. Blank for single-pulse motors.
dictionary.Fin Lat Accel (m/s2): rocket.finsLatAccel — control authority. Often the real manoeuvre limit, not loadFactorMax.
dictionary.Hard Max Range (m): rocket.maxDistance. Ballistic cut-off, NOT a launch envelope.
dictionary.Operated Distance (m): rocket.operatedDist — range over which the operator can still steer a SACLOS weapon.
dictionary.Break-Lock Tolerance (s): guidance.breakLockMaxTime — coast time on last known track before going dumb.
dictionary.Inertial Navigation: guidance.inertialNavigation — can fly to a predicted point without a lock.
dictionary.Datalink: inertialGuidance.datalink — mid-course update from the launcher.
dictionary.SACLOS Timeout (s): lineOfSightAutopilot.timeOut — how long command guidance stays live.
dictionary.EO/IR FoV (deg): opticalSeeker.fov. Small values (0.1) are TV/IIR cameras; larger are IR AAM seekers.
dictionary.EO/IR Signature Type: opticalSeeker.targetSignatureType — 'optic' means contrast/TV, absent means thermal.
dictionary.EO/IR Surface Range (m): opticalSeeker.rangeSurface — acquisition range against ground targets.
dictionary.EO/IR Min Target Radius (m): opticalSeeker.targetRadiusMin — smallest target the seeker will hold.
dictionary.IR Band Rejection Mask: opticalSeeker.bandMaskToReject — IRCCM flare rejection. Present = has some IRCCM.
dictionary.Laser Seeker Range (m): laserSeeker.range — nominal acquisition range on a designated spot.
dictionary.Laser Wind Angle Max (deg): laserSeeker.windAngleMax — off-axis tolerance while riding the spot.
dictionary.Radar Active: radarSeeker.active — the missile carries its own transmitter.
dictionary.Radar Band: radarSeeker.band — for ARMs this is the list of enemy emitter bands it can home on.
dictionary.Radar Needs Designation: radarSeeker.mandatoryDesignationSources — true means it will not fire without a handoff.
dictionary.RX Range @ Ref RCS (m): radarSeeker.receiver.range at receiver.rcs. Pitbull range against that reference RCS.
dictionary.Doppler Gate Min (m/s): radarSeeker.dopplerSpeed.minValue — closure window; notching works outside it.
dictionary.Total Impulse (kN*s): DERIVED formula: (F1*t1 + F2*t2)/1000. Best single energy proxy.

readme: War Thunder — Guided Weapon Dataset (AAM / ARM / AGM / ASM / ATGM)
Every rocketgun entry that has a guidance block. Unguided rockets are excluded.
All mechanical, read straight off the .blkx. No hand-labelling.
radarSeeker with aircraftAsTarget == false (active radar, surface/ship).
radarSeeker.active == true and aircraftAsTarget not false.
radarSeeker present, active absent/false, aircraftAsTarget not false.
opticalSeeker WITH surfaceAsTarget or groundVehiclesAsTarget (TV or IIR).
laserSeeker present. Split AGM vs ATGM by presence of a cumulativeDamage (HEAT) block.
beamRider or lineOfSightAutopilot. bulletType == "aam" overrides to AAM (Fireflash, Starstreak).
The weapon file is referenced by at least one aircraft/helicopter definition, directly or through a pylon container. 362 of 432.

70 of 432. Verified case: us_127mm_tow is a legacy file - helicopters use us_bgm_71_tow_heli instead. Ground-vehicle ATGMs are defined inline in groundmodels_weapons and never appear here. Treat these rows as unused/legacy or not-yet-mounted, not as ground-launched.
Full weapon-to-aircraft mapping lives on the 'Carriers' sheet (2,281 links). Use it as a join table.
BR = (economicRank // 3) + 1, plus 0.0 / 0.3 / 0.7 for remainder 0 / 1 / 2. Verified against F-16C Barak II = 13.7.
